question: Three consider items target the run: Q-033 and Q-075 (the root's Child nodes table still gives simple-login.backend and simple-login.web their version-1 Purpose) and Q-076 (simple-login.web's Overview cites PRD v2 Screens for three screens, though Screens draws only Home and Rooms). How are they closed?

options.label: Route each to the node whose text it is and close the run items as explained
options.consequence: The consistency stage dispatches a spec-touch on simple-login (the child table's Purpose cells, matching the touched embedded summaries) and one on simple-login.web (the citation); both are text fixes with no decision behind them.

options.label: Close them as explained with no further step
options.consequence: The root's child table keeps describing a login-only product and the web's Overview keeps a citation that does not support it.

chosen: Route each to the node whose text it is and close the run items as explained
why: Both are stale or unsupported sentences in live headers that a later reader, and hsdd-config's phase contexts, would take as current; the owning skill is hsdd-spec, and a node target gets a spec-touch in this stage. Text that only restated shipped history would have been closed with no step.
